Lower Text: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon deletes your opponent's Digimon in battle, trash their top security card.
Upper Text: [On Play] [When Digivolving] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, if this Digimon's stack has 2 or more same-level cards, return 1 of your opponent's suspended Digimon with the lowest DP to the hand.
